name: 1st Stage Suction Pressure Transmitter
description: Pressure transmitter suction 1st stage compressor 0-50 barg
limitHighConsequence: Overpressure of the suction scrubber; relief valve lifts
limitLowConsequence: Compressor surge and trip on low suction pressure
limitHighCorrectiveAction: Reduce inlet flow and check upstream choke settings
limitLowCorrectiveAction: Open recycle valve and verify upstream supply

name: 1st Stage Gear Thrust Bearing Temperature
description: Temperature transmitter gear thrust bearing 0-150 degC
limitHighConsequence: Thrust bearing damage and compressor trip
limitLowConsequence: Lube oil too viscous for bearing lubrication at start-up
limitHighCorrectiveAction: Check lube oil cooler and oil flow; reduce load
limitLowCorrectiveAction: Verify lube oil heater before start-up

name: 1st Stage Compressor Flow Transmitter
limitHighConsequence: Driver overload and high discharge temperature
limitLowConsequence: Compressor operating near the surge line
limitHighCorrectiveAction: Reduce speed or open recycle to lower throughput

name: 1st Stage Scrubber Level Transmitter
limitLowConsequence: Gas blow-by to the condensate system
limitHighCorrectiveAction: Increase drain rate and check the level control valve
limitLowCorrectiveAction: Reduce drain rate and check the level control valve

name: 1st Stage Suction Cooler dP Transmitter
description: Differential pressure transmitter suction cooler 0-500 mbar
limitLowConsequence: Cooler bypass open or transmitter fault
limitHighCorrectiveAction: Schedule cooler cleaning and check filter condition
limitLowCorrectiveAction: Check bypass valve position and transmitter calibration
